comment: The bird cut out of its reference photo onto transparency, for scene art's composite (#49). image 1 is the species' reference photo cropped to 3:4 around the bird; the output is an RGBA PNG. BiRefNet-general (MIT upstream) through the comfyui-rmbg custom node, which downloads it from the 1038lab/BiRefNet re-host on first use (art/comfybox/download-models.sh pins it); the node pack's RMBG-2.0 is CC BY-NC and must not be used (ADR-0001). packbuilder.art.Workflow fills the node titled 'image 1'.
